FEED THE QUEEN

A downloadable game

FEED THE QUEEN IS COMING OUT ON STEAM ON MAY 25TH!



This demo is now very much outdated compared to the full game. I'm temporarily disabling it. It will be back once I get around to creating a new one sometime after the game's full launch!



FEED THE QUEEN is an active incremental game with a focus on synergy-building. 

Grow your colony, hatch and upgrade various worker types, optimize your production, customize your build, evolve, and feed your Queen ever-increasing amounts of food!



Wishlist FEED THE QUEEN on STEAM!

Join the discord :)

giopadella281 days ago(+3)

For those who say that 1M/minute is impossible, you are wrong, and here is the proof.

How to do it:

  • The kitchen must prepare two dishes:
       1) brochette (trap factory)

       2) glace flambee (bug farm (hot) + orchard (ice))

  • use the foragers burrow to produce apples

explained more simply:

glace flambee makes 3x apples (if they are at maximum value they are worth 50) and brochettes (if they are at maximum value they are worth 1500)

so:

50*3 + 1500*3 = 4650

1M / 4650 = 216

So in one minute you need to make 216 apples and 216 brochettes while glace flambee is active (even if you make many more apples).



(Sorry for the English, but I'm not)
